recall_prompt: Define an amplifier, then define the amplification factor as a ratio.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Amplifier
lines: increases the strength of a weak input
steps.margin_note: First mark. 'Increases the strength of a weak signal' is the marked phrase.
steps.why: The extra energy in the output does not come from the signal — it comes from the d.c. supply. The signal only controls how much of that supply power reaches the output, which is why an amplifier needs a battery to work.
common_mistakes: Saying an amplifier increases the frequency. It increases the strength, not the frequency.
Saying it creates energy. The added energy comes from the d.c. supply.

recall.must_convey: That an amplifier is a device that increases the strength of a weak signal.
accept: raises the strength of a weak signal
increases the amplitude of the input

steps.memory_tip: Amplifier makes it bigger; it does not make it different.

steps.label: Amplification factor
lines: Amplification factor: the ratio of the
output voltage (or current) to the input
It has no unit, because it is a ratio of
two quantities of the same kind.
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Output ON TOP. A ratio the other way round is less than one.
steps.why: Writing output over input is what makes the number greater than one for an amplifier, so the order of the ratio is the whole definition. Both quantities are of the same kind, which is why the factor has no unit.
common_mistakes: Writing input divided by output. Output goes on top.
Giving the amplification factor a unit. It is a pure number.

recall.must_convey: That the amplification factor is output voltage or current divided by input voltage or current.
accept: ratio of output voltage to input voltage
output current divided by input current
reject: increases the strength of a weak signal

steps.memory_tip: Output on top — that is why the number is bigger than one.

insider_note: Two definitions, one mark each. Write the amplification factor as a ratio with output on top, and add that it has no unit.
